capabilities: , Drag tasks from Base onto grid
View day, week, and work-week calendars
Create new task notes on empty space
motivation: Most Obsidian task workflows spread state across the vault: a checkbox here, a ⏳ 2026-03-04 there, a daily-note time block somewhere else. Reschedule something and you are hand-editing three files and hoping the regexes agree.
problem: Obsidian task workflows often spread state across multiple files (checkboxes, dates, daily notes), making rescheduling and state management inconsistent.
summary: A drag-and-drop day planner that schedules real notes by moving them from a Base onto a calendar grid, using frontmatter as the single source of truth.
